gen-gf-baumans-gf-gentium-plus: Wrench-shaped curves, all drawn in one thickness. Baumans is the one that stands out and gives orders, while Gentium Plus is the text serif that quietly does the actual talking with its wide, open c.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-gowun-batang: Gowun Batang is a classic serif with terminals cut back to leave generous gaps, set under a heading of single-depth engraved lines. Paragraphs would feel literary and unhurried.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-habibi: Flat, single-weight linework gives Baumans a stamped-metal look that nothing in the serif below tries to copy. Habibi would read in a traditional, editorial way.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-inika: Inika is a classic serif with a see-through gap in every s, and it carries a traditional air. Baumans above it draws every stroke as if with a fixed pen, so the lettering feels mechanical against that warmth.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-kay-pho-du: Kay Pho Du reads as a classic serif, traditional, with counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Baumans adds the commanding single-width strokes, and that clash of machined and hand-cut is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-labrada: Pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin give Baumans a stark, drafted look beside the bookish text serif Labrada. Its wide openings on small letters would keep paragraphs dignified.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-montaga: Montaga is an editorial serif with pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished. If Baumans were made small, its crescent-wrench c would lose its command, while a large Montaga would start to look stitched.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-new-tegomin: Monoweight skeleton up top, dignified curves below. Baumans is best at issuing bold, distinctive statements, and New Tegomin, a text serif with a ring-like c, is best at traditional, steady reading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-podkova: That w with no thick or thin strokes is pure Baumans, and nothing else here looks like it. Yet Podkova, a classic serif with a broad, welcoming c, brings the bookish, traditional warmth that makes the pair work.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-rhodium-libre: Rhodium Libre is a serif with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, giving it an editorial, traditional feel. And Baumans, with every stroke ending at the same measured thickness, supplies a commanding, engineered counterpoint above it.
